seo.spokenLanguageTitle.translated: ಉಚಿತ {langName} ಚಾನೆಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ | ಫ್ರೀಟಿವಿ ಗಾರ್ಡನ್

seo.spokenLanguageDescription.en: Stream free live {langName} TV channels from around the world. No signup, no subscription required.
seo.spokenLanguageDescription.translated: ಪ್ರಪಂಚದಾದ್ಯಂತ ಉಚಿತ ಲೈವ್ {langName} ಟಿವಿ ಚಾನೆಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್ ಮಾಡಿ. ಯಾವುದೇ ಸೈನ್ ಅಪ್ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಚಂದಾದಾರಿಕೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ.

seo.wantCountryH2.en: Want channels from a specific country instead?
seo.wantCountryH2.translated: ಬದಲಿಗೆ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ದೇಶದಿಂದ ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳು ಬೇಕೇ?

seo.faqHostQ.en: Does FreeTV Garden host or upload the video streams?
seo.faqHostQ.translated: FreeTV ಗಾರ್ಡನ್ ವೀಡಿಯೊ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆಯೇ ಅಥವಾ ಅಪ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆಯೇ?

seo.faqHostA.en: No. FreeTV Garden does not host, upload or store any video files. It links to publicly available streams so you can watch them directly from the broadcaster's own servers.
seo.faqHostA.translated: ಇಲ್ಲ. FreeTV ಗಾರ್ಡನ್ ಯಾವುದೇ ವೀಡಿಯೊ ಫೈಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಅಪ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಅಥವಾ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕವಾಗಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನೀವು ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಸಾರಕರ ಸ್ವಂತ ಸರ್ವರ್‌ಗಳಿಂದ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಬಹುದು.

seo.faqCountNoneA.en: The count changes as streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.faqCountNoneA.translated: ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳು ಆನ್ ಆಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಫ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಣಿಕೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ - ಇದೀಗ ಏನು ಲೈವ್ ಆಗಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ನೋಡಲು ಮೇಲಿನ ಉಪಕರಣವನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ.

seo.faqCountFromCountriesA.en: Currently around {count} live channels from {countries} countries.
seo.faqCountFromCountriesA.translated: ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ {countries} ದೇಶಗಳಿಂದ ಸುಮಾರು {count} ಲೈವ್ ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳು.

seo.countryIntroTV.en: This page is part of {siteLink}, our free live TV tool covering 1000+ channels from 200+ countries. Here the tool opens straight to {countryName}, so you can start watching immediately in your browser - no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required.
seo.countryIntroTV.translated: ಈ ಪುಟವು {siteLink} ನ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿದೆ, 200+ ದೇಶಗಳಿಂದ 1000+ ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿರುವ ನಮ್ಮ ಉಚಿತ ಲೈವ್ ಟಿವಿ ಸಾಧನವಾಗಿದೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಉಪಕರಣವು ನೇರವಾಗಿ {countryName} ಗೆ ತೆರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನೀವು ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಬಹುದು - ಯಾವುದೇ ಸೈನ್ ಅಪ್, ಯಾವುದೇ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್, ಯಾವುದೇ ಚಂದಾದಾರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವುದೇ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ.

seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.en: {countryName}'s free-to-air TV channels are pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory, covering categories like news, entertainment, sports and music where available, and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.translated: {countryName} ನ ಉಚಿತ ಪ್ರಸಾರ ಟಿವಿ ಚಾನೆಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ iptv-org ಚಾನೆಲ್ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಿಂದ ಲೈವ್ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಸುದ್ದಿ, ಮನರಂಜನೆ, ಕ್ರೀಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಗೀತದಂತಹ ವರ್ಗಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿರುವಂತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವುದೇ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಸಾಫ್ಟ್‌ವೇರ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಪ್ಲೇ ಮಾಡಬಹುದಾಗಿದೆ. ಯಾವುದೇ ಫ್ರೀ-ಟು-ಏರ್ ಅಗ್ರಿಗೇಟರ್‌ನಂತೆ, ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳು ಆನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆಫ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರುವಂತೆ ನಿಖರವಾದ ಚಾನಲ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯು ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು.

seo.countryChannelsParagraphOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {countryName} channel, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphOne.translated: FreeTV Garden ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ {count} ಲೈವ್ {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, {names} ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ — ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ iptv-org ಚಾನಲ್ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಿಂದ ಲೈವ್ ಅನ್ನು ಎಳೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವುದೇ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಸಾಫ್ಟ್‌ವೇರ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಪ್ಲೇ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ಯಾವುದೇ ಫ್ರೀ-ಟು-ಏರ್ ಅಗ್ರಿಗೇಟರ್‌ನಂತೆ, ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳು ಆನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆಫ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರುವಂತೆ ನಿಖರವಾದ ಚಾನಲ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯು ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು.

As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.translated: FreeTV Garden ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ {names} ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ {count} ಲೈವ್ {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ — ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ iptv-org ಚಾನೆಲ್ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಿಂದ ಲೈವ್ ಅನ್ನು ಎಳೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವುದೇ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಸಾಫ್ಟ್‌ವೇರ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಪ್ಲೇ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ಯಾವುದೇ ಫ್ರೀ-ಟು-ಏರ್ ಅಗ್ರಿಗೇಟರ್‌ನಂತೆ, ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳು ಆನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆಫ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರುವಂತೆ ನಿಖರವಾದ ಚಾನಲ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯು ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಾಧನದಲ್ಲಿ {countryName} ಟಿವಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಯಾವುದೇ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್ ಅಥವಾ ಖಾತೆಯ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ಈ ಪುಟವು ಯಾವುದೇ ಸಾಧನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ - ಕೇವಲ ಚಾನಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ಲೇ ಒತ್ತಿರಿ.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Chrome ನಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ, ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಲು {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ನಂತರ ಉತ್ತಮ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆಗಾಗಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಪರದೆ ಬಟನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಬಾರಿ ತ್ವರಿತ ಪ್ರವೇಶಕ್ಕಾಗಿ, ಕ್ರೋಮ್ ಮೆನು ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್-ರೀತಿಯ ಐಕಾನ್ ರಚಿಸಲು "ಹೋಮ್ ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್‌ಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸು" ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: ಸಫಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮಿಂಗ್ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಲು ಯಾವುದೇ {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ. ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಐಕಾನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಆಪ್ ಸ್ಟೋರ್‌ನಿಂದ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಡೌನ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡದೆಯೇ ಒಂದು-ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಪ್ರವೇಶಕ್ಕಾಗಿ "ಹೋಮ್ ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್‌ಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸು" ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: ಯಾವುದೇ ಆಧುನಿಕ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ - Chrome, Safari, Firefox ಅಥವಾ Edge. {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್ ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯಾಕುಲತೆ-ಮುಕ್ತ, ಟಿವಿ ತರಹದ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆಯ ಅನುಭವಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಪ್ಲೇಯರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಪರದೆ ಐಕಾನ್ ಬಳಸಿ.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಟಿವಿಯ ಅಂತರ್ನಿರ್ಮಿತ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ ಅಥವಾ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪರದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು Chromecast ಅಥವಾ AirPlay ಬಳಸಿಕೊಂಡು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫೋನ್ ಅಥವಾ ಲ್ಯಾಪ್‌ಟಾಪ್‌ನಿಂದ ಬಿತ್ತರಿಸಿ.

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: ಸಂವಾದಾತ್ಮಕ 3D ಗ್ಲೋಬ್ ಅನ್ನು ತಿರುಗಿಸಲು {homeLink} ಗೆ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಾವು ಬೆಂಬಲಿಸುವ 200+ ದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದನ್ನಾದರೂ ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ ಅಥವಾ {countriesLink} ಬ್ರೌಸ್ ಮಾಡಿ.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: FreeTV ಗಾರ್ಡನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ {countryName} ಟಿವಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದು ಉಚಿತವೇ?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: ಹೌದು. FreeTV ಗಾರ್ಡನ್ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕವಾಗಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ ಫ್ರೀ-ಟು-ಏರ್ (FTA) ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟುಗೂಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಯಾವುದೇ ಚಂದಾದಾರಿಕೆ, ಖಾತೆ ಅಥವಾ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಸುಮಾರು {count} ಲೈವ್ ಚಾನೆಲ್‌ಗಳು, {categories} ನಂತಹ ವರ್ಗಗಳನ್ನು ವ್ಯಾಪಿಸಿದೆ.

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳು ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆಫ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರುವಾಗ ಚಾನಲ್ ಎಣಿಕೆಯು ಆಗಾಗ್ಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ - ಇದೀಗ ಲೈವ್ ಏನಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ನೋಡಲು ಮೇಲಿನ ಪರಿಕರವನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: ಈ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ iptv-org ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಿಂದ ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತವಾಗಿ ನವೀಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: ಕೆಲವು {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳು ಏಕೆ ಬಫರ್ ಆಗುತ್ತವೆ ಅಥವಾ ಲೋಡ್ ಆಗಲು ವಿಫಲವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: ನೀವು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಬ್ರಾಡ್‌ಕಾಸ್ಟರ್‌ನ ಸ್ವಂತ ಸರ್ವರ್‌ಗೆ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದೀರಿ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ವೇಗ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹತೆಯು ಅವರ ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿರುತ್ತದೆ, ನಮ್ಮದಲ್ಲ. ಒಂದು ಚಾನಲ್ ಲೋಡ್ ಆಗದಿದ್ದರೆ, ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: ನನ್ನ ಫೋನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಾನು {countryName} ಸುದ್ದಿ ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಲೈವ್ ಆಗಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಬಹುದೇ?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: ಹೌದು — ಯಾವುದೇ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್ ಡೌನ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡದೆಯೇ ಯಾವುದೇ ಫೋನ್ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ಲೇಯರ್ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ, ಸುದ್ದಿ ಚಾನಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ತಮ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆಗಾಗಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಪರದೆಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: ಇದು ಯಾವುದೇ {countryName} ಪ್ರಸಾರಕರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್ ಆಗಿದೆಯೇ?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: ಇಲ್ಲ. FreeTV ಗಾರ್ಡನ್ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕವಾಗಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಮಾಡುವ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಲಾದ ಯಾವುದೇ ಬ್ರಾಡ್‌ಕಾಸ್ಟರ್‌ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಇದು ಸಂಯೋಜಿತವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ, ಅನುಮೋದಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿಲ್ಲ ಅಥವಾ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

seo.faqHostQ.en: Does FreeTV Garden host or upload the video streams?
seo.faqHostQ.translated: FreeTV ഗാർഡൻ വീഡിയോ സ്ട്രീമുകൾ ഹോസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്യുന്നുണ്ടോ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ അപ്‌ലോഡ് ചെയ്യുന്നുണ്ടോ?

seo.faqHostA.en: No. FreeTV Garden does not host, upload or store any video files. It links to publicly available streams so you can watch them directly from the broadcaster's own servers.
seo.faqHostA.translated: ഇല്ല. FreeTV ഗാർഡൻ ഏതെങ്കിലും വീഡിയോ ഫയലുകൾ ഹോസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്യുകയോ അപ്‌ലോഡ് ചെയ്യുകയോ സംഭരിക്കുകയോ ചെയ്യുന്നില്ല. ഇത് പൊതുവായി ലഭ്യമായ സ്ട്രീമുകളിലേക്ക് ലിങ്ക് ചെയ്യുന്നതിനാൽ ബ്രോഡ്കാസ്റ്ററുടെ സ്വന്തം സെർവറുകളിൽ നിന്ന് നിങ്ങൾക്ക് അവ നേരിട്ട് കാണാനാകും.

seo.faqCountNoneA.en: The count changes as streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.faqCountNoneA.translated: സ്ട്രീമുകൾ ഓണാകുമ്പോഴും ഓഫ്‌ലൈനിലും പോകുമ്പോൾ എണ്ണം മാറുന്നു — ഇപ്പോൾ തത്സമയം എന്താണെന്ന് കാണാൻ മുകളിലെ ടൂൾ തുറക്കുക.

seo.countryIntroTV.en: This page is part of {siteLink}, our free live TV tool covering 1000+ channels from 200+ countries. Here the tool opens straight to {countryName}, so you can start watching immediately in your browser - no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required.

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} ചാനലുകൾ കാണുന്നതിന് ആപ്പോ അക്കൗണ്ടോ ആവശ്യമില്ല. ഏത് ഉപകരണത്തിലും നിങ്ങളുടെ ബ്രൗസറിൽ ഈ പേജ് നേരിട്ട് പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു - ഒരു ചാനലിൽ ടാപ്പുചെയ്‌ത് പ്ലേ അമർത്തുക.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Chrome-ൽ ഈ പേജ് തുറക്കുക, കാണുന്നത് ആരംഭിക്കാൻ ഒരു {countryName} ചാനൽ ടാപ്പുചെയ്യുക, തുടർന്ന് മികച്ച കാഴ്‌ചയ്‌ക്കായി പൂർണ്ണസ്‌ക്രീൻ ബട്ടൺ ഉപയോഗിക്കുക. അടുത്ത തവണ ദ്രുത ആക്‌സസിന്, Chrome മെനുവിൽ ടാപ്പ് ചെയ്‌ത് ഒരു ആപ്പ് പോലുള്ള ഐക്കൺ സൃഷ്‌ടിക്കാൻ "ഹോം സ്‌ക്രീനിലേക്ക് ചേർക്കുക" തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: സഫാരിയിൽ ഈ പേജ് തുറന്ന് തൽക്ഷണം സ്ട്രീമിംഗ് ആരംഭിക്കാൻ ഏതെങ്കിലും {countryName} ചാനലിൽ ടാപ്പ് ചെയ്യുക. ആപ്പ് സ്റ്റോറിൽ നിന്ന് ഒരു ആപ്പ് ഡൗൺലോഡ് ചെയ്യാതെ തന്നെ ഒറ്റ ടാപ്പ് ആക്‌സസിന് പങ്കിടൽ ഐക്കണിൽ ടാപ്പ് ചെയ്‌ത് "ഹോം സ്‌ക്രീനിലേക്ക് ചേർക്കുക" തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: ഏത് ആധുനിക ബ്രൗസറും പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു - Chrome, Safari, Firefox അല്ലെങ്കിൽ Edge. ഒരു {countryName} ചാനൽ തുറന്ന് പ്ലെയറിലെ പൂർണ്ണസ്‌ക്രീൻ ഐക്കൺ ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ശ്രദ്ധ വ്യതിചലിക്കാത്ത, ടിവി പോലുള്ള കാഴ്ചാനുഭവം നേടുക.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: നിങ്ങളുടെ ടിവിയുടെ അന്തർനിർമ്മിത ബ്രൗസറിൽ ഈ പേജ് തുറക്കുക, അല്ലെങ്കിൽ വലിയ സ്‌ക്രീനിൽ {countryName} ചാനലുകൾ കാണുന്നതിന് Chromecast അല്ലെങ്കിൽ AirPlay ഉപയോഗിച്ച് നിങ്ങളുടെ ഫോണിൽ നിന്നോ ലാപ്‌ടോപ്പിൽ നിന്നോ കാസ്‌റ്റ് ചെയ്യുക.

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: സംവേദനാത്മക 3D ഗ്ലോബ് കറക്കുന്നതിന് {homeLink} ലേക്ക് മടങ്ങുക, ഞങ്ങൾ പിന്തുണയ്ക്കുന്ന 200+ രാജ്യങ്ങളിൽ ഏതെങ്കിലും തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക, അല്ലെങ്കിൽ {countriesLink} ബ്രൗസ് ചെയ്യുക.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: FreeTV ഗാർഡനിൽ {countryName} ടിവി കാണുന്നത് സൗജന്യമാണോ?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: അതെ. ഓൺലൈനിൽ പൊതുവായി ലഭ്യമായ ഫ്രീ-ടു-എയർ (FTA) ചാനലുകളെ FreeTV ഗാർഡൻ സംഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു. കാണുന്നതിന് സബ്‌സ്‌ക്രിപ്‌ഷനോ അക്കൗണ്ടോ ആപ്പോ ആവശ്യമില്ല.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: നിലവിൽ {count} തത്സമയ ചാനലുകൾ, {categories} പോലെയുള്ള വിഭാഗങ്ങളിൽ വ്യാപിച്ചുകിടക്കുന്നു.

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: പബ്ലിക് സ്ട്രീമുകൾ ഓണാകുകയും ഓഫ്‌ലൈനായിരിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നതിനാൽ ചാനലുകളുടെ എണ്ണം ഇടയ്‌ക്കിടെ മാറുന്നു - ഇപ്പോൾ തത്സമയം എന്താണെന്ന് കാണാൻ മുകളിലെ ടൂൾ തുറക്കുക.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: ഈ ലിസ്റ്റ് പൊതു iptv-org ഡയറക്ടറിയിൽ നിന്ന് സ്വയമേവ അപ്ഡേറ്റ് ചെയ്യുന്നു.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: എന്തുകൊണ്ടാണ് ചില {countryName} ചാനലുകൾ ബഫർ ചെയ്യുന്നത് അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ലോഡ് ചെയ്യുന്നതിൽ പരാജയപ്പെടുന്നത്?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: നിങ്ങൾ നേരിട്ട് ബ്രോഡ്കാസ്റ്ററുടെ സ്വന്തം സെർവറിലേക്ക് കണക്റ്റുചെയ്യുന്നു, അതിനാൽ വേഗതയും വിശ്വാസ്യതയും അവരുടെ ഇൻഫ്രാസ്ട്രക്ചറിനെ ആശ്രയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു, ഞങ്ങളുടേതല്ല. ഒരു ചാനൽ ലോഡായില്ലെങ്കിൽ, ലിസ്റ്റിൽ നിന്ന് മറ്റൊന്ന് പരീക്ഷിക്കുക.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: എനിക്ക് എൻ്റെ ഫോണിൽ {countryName} വാർത്താ ചാനലുകൾ തത്സമയം കാണാൻ കഴിയുമോ?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: അതെ — ആപ്പ് ഡൗൺലോഡ് ഇല്ലാത്ത ഏത് ഫോൺ ബ്രൗസറിലും പ്ലെയർ പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു. ഈ പേജ് തുറക്കുക, ഒരു വാർത്താ ചാനൽ ടാപ്പ് ചെയ്യുക, മികച്ച കാഴ്‌ചയ്‌ക്കായി പൂർണ്ണസ്‌ക്രീൻ ഉപയോഗിക്കുക.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: ഇത് ഏതെങ്കിലും {countryName} ബ്രോഡ്‌കാസ്റ്ററിൻ്റെ ഔദ്യോഗിക വെബ്‌സൈറ്റാണോ?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: ഇല്ല. ഫ്രീടിവി ഗാർഡൻ പൊതുവായി ലഭ്യമായ സ്ട്രീമുകളിലേക്ക് ലിങ്ക് ചെയ്യുന്ന ഒരു സ്വതന്ത്ര ഡയറക്ടറിയാണ്. ഈ പേജിൽ ലിസ്‌റ്റ് ചെയ്‌തിരിക്കുന്ന ഏതെങ്കിലും ബ്രോഡ്‌കാസ്‌റ്ററുമായി ഇത് അഫിലിയേറ്റ് ചെയ്‌തതോ അംഗീകരിക്കുന്നതോ പ്രവർത്തിപ്പിക്കുന്നതോ അല്ല.

seo.countryIntroTV.translated: हे पृष्ठ {siteLink} चा भाग आहे, 200+ देशांमधील 1000+ चॅनेल कव्हर करणारे आमचे मोफत थेट टीव्ही साधन. येथे साधन थेट {countryName} वर उघडते, जेणेकरून तुम्ही तुमच्या ब्राउझरमध्ये ताबडतोब पाहणे सुरू करू शकता - साइनअप नाही, ॲप नाही, सदस्यता नाही आणि क्रेडिट कार्ड आवश्यक नाही.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: तुमच्या डिव्हाइसवर {countryName} टीव्ही कसा पाहायचा

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} चॅनेल पाहण्यासाठी कोणतेही ॲप किंवा खाते आवश्यक नाही. हे पृष्ठ कोणत्याही डिव्हाइसवर तुमच्या ब्राउझरमध्ये थेट कार्य करते - फक्त चॅनेल टॅप करा आणि प्ले दाबा.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: हे पृष्ठ Chrome मध्ये उघडा, पाहणे सुरू करण्यासाठी {countryName} चॅनेल टॅप करा, नंतर सर्वोत्तम दृश्यासाठी पूर्णस्क्रीन बटण वापरा. पुढच्या वेळी द्रुत प्रवेशासाठी, Chrome मेनू टॅप करा आणि ॲप-सारखे चिन्ह तयार करण्यासाठी "होम स्क्रीनवर जोडा" निवडा.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: हे पृष्ठ Safari मध्ये उघडा आणि स्ट्रीमिंग सुरू करण्यासाठी कोणतेही {countryName} चॅनल टॅप करा. शेअर आयकॉनवर टॅप करा आणि ॲप स्टोअरमधून ॲप डाउनलोड न करता एक-टॅप ऍक्सेससाठी "होम स्क्रीनवर जोडा" निवडा.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: कोणताही आधुनिक ब्राउझर कार्य करतो - क्रोम, सफारी, फायरफॉक्स किंवा एज. एक {countryName} चॅनल उघडा आणि विचलित-मुक्त, टीव्ही सारखा पाहण्याच्या अनुभवासाठी प्लेअरमधील फुलस्क्रीन चिन्ह वापरा.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: हे पृष्ठ तुमच्या टीव्हीच्या अंगभूत ब्राउझरमध्ये उघडा किंवा मोठ्या स्क्रीनवर {countryName} चॅनेल पाहण्यासाठी Chromecast किंवा AirPlay वापरून तुमच्या फोन किंवा लॅपटॉपवरून कास्ट करा.

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: परस्परसंवादी 3D ग्लोब फिरवण्यासाठी {homeLink} वर परत जा आणि आम्ही समर्थन देत असलेल्या 200+ देशांपैकी कोणताही निवडा किंवा {countriesLink} ब्राउझ करा.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: FreeTV गार्डनवर {countryName} टीव्ही पाहणे विनामूल्य आहे का?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: होय. फ्रीटीव्ही गार्डन फ्री-टू-एअर (FTA) चॅनेल एकत्रित करते जे सार्वजनिकपणे ऑनलाइन उपलब्ध आहेत. पाहण्यासाठी कोणतेही सदस्यता, खाते किंवा ॲप आवश्यक नाही.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: सध्या सुमारे {count} थेट चॅनेल, {categories} सारख्या श्रेणींमध्ये पसरलेले.

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: सार्वजनिक प्रवाह चालू असताना आणि ऑफलाइन असल्याने चॅनेलची संख्या वारंवार बदलते — सध्या काय लाइव्ह आहे हे पाहण्यासाठी वरील साधन उघडा.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: ही सूची सार्वजनिक iptv-org निर्देशिकेतून आपोआप अपडेट होते.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: काही {countryName} चॅनेल बफर किंवा लोड होण्यास अयशस्वी का होतात?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: तुम्ही ब्रॉडकास्टरच्या स्वतःच्या सर्व्हरशी थेट कनेक्ट करत आहात, त्यामुळे वेग आणि विश्वासार्हता त्यांच्या पायाभूत सुविधांवर अवलंबून असते, आमच्यावर नाही. एक चॅनेल लोड होत नसल्यास, सूचीमधून दुसरे चॅनेल वापरून पहा.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: मी माझ्या फोनवर {countryName} न्यूज चॅनेल लाईव्ह पाहू शकतो का?

seo.faqHostA.translated: ନା। ମାଗଣା ଟିଭି ଗାର୍ଡେନ୍ କ video ଣସି ଭିଡିଓ ଫାଇଲ୍ ହୋଷ୍ଟ, ଅପଲୋଡ୍ କିମ୍ବା ଗଚ୍ଛିତ କରେ ନାହିଁ | ଏହା ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ଭାବରେ ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ଷ୍ଟ୍ରିମ୍ ସହିତ ଲିଙ୍କ୍ ହୋଇଛି ଯାହା ଦ୍ you ାରା ଆପଣ ଏହାକୁ ସିଧାସଳଖ ବ୍ରଡକାଷ୍ଟରର ନିଜସ୍ୱ ସର୍ଭରରୁ ଦେଖିପାରିବେ |

seo.faqCountNoneA.en: The count changes as streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.faqCountNoneA.translated: ଷ୍ଟ୍ରିମ୍ ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଏବଂ ଅଫଲାଇନ୍ରେ ଗଣନା ବଦଳିଥାଏ - ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ଲାଇଭ୍ ଦେଖିବା ପାଇଁ ଉପର ଉପକରଣ ଖୋଲ |

seo.faqCountFromCountriesA.en: Currently around {count} live channels from {countries} countries.
seo.faqCountFromCountriesA.translated: ସମ୍ପ୍ରତି {count} ଦେଶରୁ ପ୍ରାୟ {count} ଲାଇଭ୍ ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ୍ |

seo.countryIntroTV.en: This page is part of {siteLink}, our free live TV tool covering 1000+ channels from 200+ countries. Here the tool opens straight to {countryName}, so you can start watching immediately in your browser - no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required.
seo.countryIntroTV.translated: ଏହି ପୃଷ୍ଠା {siteLink} ର ଏକ ଅଂଶ, ଆମର ମାଗଣା ଲାଇଭ୍ ଟିଭି ଉପକରଣ 200+ ଦେଶରୁ 1000+ ଚ୍ୟାନେଲକୁ ଆଚ୍ଛାଦନ କରେ | ଏଠାରେ ଟୁଲ୍ ସିଧା {countryName} କୁ ଖୋଲିବ, ତେଣୁ ତୁମେ ତୁମର ବ୍ରାଉଜରରେ ତୁରନ୍ତ ଦେଖିବା ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିପାରିବ - କ sign ଣସି ସାଇନ୍ ଅପ୍ ନାହିଁ, କ app ଣସି ଆପ୍ ନାହିଁ, କ subs ଣସି ସଦସ୍ୟତା ନାହିଁ, ଏବଂ କ credit ଣସି କ୍ରେଡିଟ୍ କାର୍ଡ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ନାହିଁ |

seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.en: {countryName}'s free-to-air TV channels are pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory, covering categories like news, entertainment, sports and music where available, and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.translated: {countryName} ର ମାଗଣା-ଟୁ-ଏୟାର ଟିଭି ଚ୍ୟାନେଲଗୁଡିକ ସର୍ବସାଧାରଣ iptv-org ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ ଡିରେକ୍ଟୋରୀରୁ ସିଧା ପ୍ରସାରିତ ହୁଏ, ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ଖବର, ମନୋରଞ୍ଜନ, କ୍ରୀଡା ଏବଂ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ପରି ବର୍ଗଗୁଡିକ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୂକ୍ତ କରେ ଏବଂ କ additional ଣସି ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ସଫ୍ଟୱେୟାର ବିନା ତୁରନ୍ତ ତୁମର ବ୍ରାଉଜରରେ ଖେଳାଯାଇପାରିବ | ଯେକ any ଣସି ଫ୍ରି-ଟୁ-ଏୟାର ଏଗ୍ରିଗେଟର୍ ପରି, ସଠିକ୍ ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ୍ ତାଲିକା ଦିନକୁ ଦିନ ବଦଳିପାରେ ଯେହେତୁ ଷ୍ଟ୍ରିମ୍ ଚାଲୁଥାଏ ଏବଂ ଅଫଲାଇନରେ |

seo.countryChannelsParagraphOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {countryName} channel, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphOne.translated: ମାଗଣା ଟିଭି ଗାର୍ଡେନ୍ ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ {count} ଲାଇଭ୍ {countryName} ଚ୍ୟାନେଲକୁ ତାଲିକାଭୁକ୍ତ କରେ, {names} ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୂକ୍ତ କରି - ସର୍ବସାଧାରଣ iptv-org ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ ଡିରେକ୍ଟୋରୀରୁ ଲାଇଭ୍ ଟାଣିଲା ଏବଂ ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ସଫ୍ଟୱେର୍ ବିନା ତୁରନ୍ତ ତୁମର ବ୍ରାଉଜର୍ରେ ଚଲାଯାଇପାରିବ | ଯେକ any ଣସି ଫ୍ରି-ଟୁ-ଏୟାର ଏଗ୍ରିଗେଟର୍ ପରି, ସଠିକ୍ ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ୍ ତାଲିକା ଦିନକୁ ଦିନ ବଦଳିପାରେ ଯେହେତୁ ଷ୍ଟ୍ରିମ୍ ଚାଲୁଥାଏ ଏବଂ ଅଫଲାଇନରେ |

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଡିଭାଇସରେ {countryName} ଟିଭି କିପରି ଦେଖିବେ |

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ ଦେଖିବା ପାଇଁ କ app ଣସି ଆପ୍ କିମ୍ବା ଆକାଉଣ୍ଟ୍ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ନାହିଁ | ଯେକ any ଣସି ଉପକରଣରେ ଏହି ପୃଷ୍ଠା ସିଧାସଳଖ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବ୍ରାଉଜରରେ କାମ କରେ - କେବଳ ଏକ ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରି ପ୍ଲେ ଦବାନ୍ତୁ |

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: କ୍ରୋମରେ ଏହି ପୃଷ୍ଠା ଖୋଲ, ଦେଖିବା ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଏକ {countryName} ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ୍ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କର, ତାପରେ ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଦୃଶ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ଫୁଲ୍ ସ୍କ୍ରିନ୍ ବଟନ୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର କର | ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସମୟରେ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଆକସେସ୍ ପାଇଁ, କ୍ରୋମ୍ ମେନୁ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଏକ ଆପ୍ ପରି ଆଇକନ୍ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିବାକୁ “ହୋମ ସ୍କ୍ରିନରେ ଯୋଡନ୍ତୁ” ବାଛନ୍ତୁ |

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: ସଫାରିରେ ଏହି ପୃଷ୍ଠା ଖୋଲ ଏବଂ ତୁରନ୍ତ ଷ୍ଟ୍ରିମିଂ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବାକୁ ଯେକ any ଣସି {countryName} ଚ୍ୟାନେଲକୁ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କର | ସେୟାର୍ ଆଇକନ୍ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଆପ୍ ଷ୍ଟୋରରୁ ଏକ ଆପ୍ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ ନକରି ଏକ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ଆକ୍ସେସ୍ ପାଇଁ “ହୋମ ସ୍କ୍ରିନରେ ଯୋଡନ୍ତୁ” ଚୟନ କରନ୍ତୁ |

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: ଯେକ Any ଣସି ଆଧୁନିକ ବ୍ରାଉଜର୍ କାମ କରେ - କ୍ରୋମ୍, ସଫାରି, ଫାୟାରଫକ୍ସ କିମ୍ବା ଏଜ୍ | ଏକ {countryName} ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ ଖୋଲନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଏକ ବିଭ୍ରାଟମୁକ୍ତ, ଟିଭି ପରି ଦେଖିବା ଅଭିଜ୍ଞତା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ଲେୟାରରେ ଫୁଲ୍ ସ୍କ୍ରିନ୍ ଆଇକନ୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ |

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଟିଭିର ବିଲ୍ଟ-ଇନ୍ ବ୍ରାଉଜରରେ ଏହି ପୃଷ୍ଠା ଖୋଲନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ବଡ ପରଦାରେ {countryName} ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ ଦେଖିବା ପାଇଁ କ୍ରୋମକାଷ୍ଟ କିମ୍ବା ଏୟାରପ୍ଲେ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ଏହାକୁ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଫୋନ୍ କିମ୍ବା ଲାପଟପ୍ ରୁ ପକାନ୍ତୁ |

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: ଇଣ୍ଟରାକ୍ଟିଭ୍ 3D ଗ୍ଲୋବକୁ ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣନ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଏବଂ ଆମେ ସମର୍ଥନ କରୁଥିବା 200+ ଦେଶ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଯେକ pick ଣସି ଗୋଟିଏ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା {countriesLink} ବ୍ରାଉଜ୍ କରିବାକୁ {homeLink} କୁ ଫେରନ୍ତୁ |

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: FreeTV ଗାର୍ଡେନରେ {countryName} ଟିଭି ଦେଖିବା ମାଗଣା କି?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: ହଁ ମାଗଣା ଟିଭି ଗାର୍ଡେନ୍ ଏଗ୍ରିଗେଟ୍ ଫ୍ରି-ଟୁ-ଏୟାର (FTA) ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ ଯାହା ଅନଲାଇନରେ ସର୍ବସାଧାରଣରେ ଉପଲବ୍ଧ | ଦେଖିବା ପାଇଁ କ subs ଣସି ସବସ୍କ୍ରିପସନ୍, ଆକାଉଣ୍ଟ୍ କିମ୍ବା ଆପ୍ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ନାହିଁ |

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?
seo.countryFaqCountQ.translated: ଫ୍ରି ଟିଭି ଗାର୍ଡେନରେ କେତେ {countryName} ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ ଅଛି?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: ସମ୍ପ୍ରତି {count} ଲାଇଭ୍ ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ୍, {categories} ପରି ବର୍ଗଗୁଡିକ ବିସ୍ତାର କରେ |

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: ସର୍ବସାଧାରଣ ଷ୍ଟ୍ରିମ୍ ଏବଂ ଅଫଲାଇନ୍ ଚାଲୁଥିବାରୁ ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ ଗଣନା ବାରମ୍ବାର ବଦଳିଥାଏ - ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ଲାଇଭ୍ ଦେଖିବା ପାଇଁ ଉପର ଉପକରଣ ଖୋଲନ୍ତୁ |

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: ଏହି ତାଲିକା ସର୍ବସାଧାରଣ iptv-org ଡିରେକ୍ଟୋରୀରୁ ସ୍ୱୟଂଚାଳିତ ଭାବରେ ଅଦ୍ୟତନ ହୁଏ |

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: କାହିଁକି କିଛି {countryName} ଚ୍ୟାନେଲ ବଫର୍ କିମ୍ବା ଲୋଡ୍ କରିବାରେ ବିଫଳ ହୁଏ?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.

seo.faqHostA.en: No. FreeTV Garden does not host, upload or store any video files. It links to publicly available streams so you can watch them directly from the broadcaster's own servers.
seo.faqHostA.translated: නැත. FreeTV Garden කිසිදු වීඩියෝ ගොනු සත්කාරකත්වය, උඩුගත කිරීම හෝ ගබඩා නොකරයි. එය ප්‍රසිද්ධියේ ලබා ගත හැකි ප්‍රවාහ වෙත සබැඳි වන අතර එමඟින් ඔබට ඒවා විකාශකයාගේම සේවාදායකයෙන් කෙලින්ම නැරඹිය හැකිය.

seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.en: {countryName}'s free-to-air TV channels are pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory, covering categories like news, entertainment, sports and music where available, and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.translated: {countryName} හි නොමිලේ-ගුවන් රූපවාහිනී නාලිකා පොදු iptv-org නාලිකා නාමාවලියෙන් සජීවීව ඇද ගන්නා අතර, ප්‍රවෘත්ති, විනෝදාස්වාදය, ක්‍රීඩා සහ සංගීතය වැනි ප්‍රවර්ග ආවරණය වන පරිදි ලබා ගත හැකි අතර අමතර මෘදුකාංග නොමැතිව ඔබේ බ්‍රවුසරයේ ක්ෂණිකව වාදනය කළ හැකිය. ඕනෑම නොමිලේ-ගුවනට-ගුවන් සංග්‍රහයක් සමඟින්, ප්‍රවාහයන් ක්‍රියාත්මක වන විට සහ නොබැඳි ලෙස නිවැරදි නාලිකා ලැයිස්තුව දිනෙන් දින වෙනස් විය හැක.

seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {countryName} channels, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.translated: FreeTV Garden දැනට {names} ඇතුළුව {count} සජීවී {countryName} නාලිකා ලැයිස්තුගත කරයි — පොදු iptv-org නාලිකා නාමාවලියෙන් සජීවීව ඇද ගන්නා අතර අමතර මෘදුකාංග නොමැතිව ඔබේ බ්‍රවුසරයේ ක්ෂණිකව වාදනය කළ හැක. ඕනෑම නොමිලේ-ගුවනට-ගුවන් සංග්‍රහයක් සමඟින්, ප්‍රවාහයන් ක්‍රියාත්මක වන විට සහ නොබැඳි ලෙස නිවැරදි නාලිකා ලැයිස්තුව දිනෙන් දින වෙනස් විය හැක.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: ඔබගේ උපාංගයේ {countryName} TV නරඹන ආකාරය

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} නාලිකා නැරඹීමට යෙදුමක් හෝ ගිණුමක් අවශ්‍ය නොවේ. මෙම පිටුව ඕනෑම උපාංගයක ඔබගේ බ්‍රවුසරයේ කෙලින්ම ක්‍රියා කරයි - නාලිකාවක් තට්ටු කර Play ඔබන්න.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Chrome හි මෙම පිටුව විවෘත කරන්න, නැරඹීම ආරම්භ කිරීමට {countryName} නාලිකාවක් තට්ටු කරන්න, ඉන්පසු හොඳම දසුන සඳහා පූර්ණ තිර බොත්තම භාවිතා කරන්න. ඊළඟ වතාවේ ඉක්මන් ප්‍රවේශය සඳහා, ක්‍රෝම් මෙනුව තට්ටු කර යෙදුම් වැනි නිරූපකයක් සෑදීමට "මුල් තිරයට එක් කරන්න" තෝරන්න.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: මෙම පිටුව Safari හි විවෘත කර ක්ෂණිකව ප්‍රවාහය ආරම්භ කිරීමට ඕනෑම {countryName} නාලිකාවක් තට්ටු කරන්න. App Store වෙතින් යෙදුමක් බාගැනීමකින් තොරව එක්-තට්ටු ප්‍රවේශයක් සඳහා බෙදාගැනීමේ නිරූපකය තට්ටු කර "මුල් තිරයට එක් කරන්න" තෝරන්න.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: ඕනෑම නවීන බ්රවුසරයක් ක්රියා කරයි - Chrome, Safari, Firefox හෝ Edge. {countryName} නාලිකාවක් විවෘත කර අවධානය වෙනතකට යොමු නොවන, රූපවාහිනිය වැනි නැරඹීමේ අත්දැකීමක් සඳහා ක්‍රීඩකයා තුළ පූර්ණ තිර නිරූපකය භාවිතා කරන්න.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: මෙම පිටුව ඔබේ රූපවාහිනියේ ඇති බ්‍රවුසරයේ විවෘත කරන්න, නැතහොත් විශාල තිරයේ {countryName} නාලිකා නැරඹීමට Chromecast හෝ AirPlay භාවිතයෙන් ඔබේ දුරකථනයෙන් හෝ ලැප්ටොප් පරිගණකයෙන් එය විකාශ කරන්න.

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: අන්තර්ක්‍රියාකාරී ත්‍රිමාණ ගෝලය කරකැවීමට {homeLink} වෙත ආපසු ගොස් අප සහය දක්වන රටවල් 200+ න් ඕනෑම එකක් තෝරන්න, නැතහොත් {countriesLink} බ්‍රවුස් කරන්න.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: FreeTV උද්‍යානයේ {countryName} TV නැරඹීම නොමිලේද?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: ඔව්. FreeTV Garden විසින් අන්තර්ජාලය හරහා ප්‍රසිද්ධියේ ලබා ගත හැකි Free-to-Air (FTA) නාලිකා එකතු කරයි. නැරඹීමට දායකත්වයක්, ගිණුමක් හෝ යෙදුමක් අවශ්‍ය නොවේ.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?
seo.countryFaqCountQ.translated: FreeTV Garden සතුව {countryName} නාලිකා කීයක් තිබේද?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: දැනට {count} සජීවී නාලිකා, {categories} වැනි ප්‍රවර්ග විහිදී ඇත.

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: පොදු ප්‍රවාහ ක්‍රියාත්මක වන විට සහ නොබැඳි ලෙස නාලිකා ගණන නිතර වෙනස් වේ - දැන් සජීවීව ඇති දේ බැලීමට ඉහත මෙවලම විවෘත කරන්න.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: මෙම ලැයිස්තුව පොදු iptv-org නාමාවලියෙන් ස්වයංක්‍රීයව යාවත්කාලීන වේ.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: සමහර {countryName} නාලිකා බෆර කරන්නේ හෝ පූරණය වීමට අසමත් වන්නේ ඇයි?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: ඔබ සෘජුවම සම්බන්ධ වන්නේ විකාශකයාගේම සේවාදායකයට, එබැවින් වේගය සහ විශ්වසනීයත්වය රඳා පවතින්නේ ඔවුන්ගේ යටිතල පහසුකම් මත මිස අපගේ නොවේ. එක් නාලිකාවක් පූරණය නොවන්නේ නම්, ලැයිස්තුවෙන් තවත් එකක් උත්සාහ කරන්න.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: මට මගේ දුරකථනයෙන් {countryName} පුවත් නාලිකා සජීවීව නැරඹිය හැකිද?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: ඔව් — ක්‍රීඩකයා යෙදුම් බාගැනීම් නොමැතිව ඕනෑම දුරකථන බ්‍රවුසරයක ක්‍රියා කරයි. මෙම පිටුව විවෘත කරන්න, පුවත් නාලිකාවක් තට්ටු කරන්න, සහ හොඳම දසුන සඳහා පූර්ණ තිරය භාවිතා කරන්න.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: මෙය කිසියම් {countryName} විකාශකයෙකුගේ නිල වෙබ් අඩවියද?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: No. FreeTV Garden යනු ප්‍රසිද්ධියේ ලබා ගත හැකි ප්‍රවාහ වෙත සම්බන්ධ කරන ස්වාධීන නාමාවලියකි. එය මෙම පිටුවේ ලැයිස්තුගත කර ඇති කිසිදු විකාශකයෙකු සමඟ අනුබද්ධිත, අනුමත කර හෝ ක්‍රියාත්මක නොවේ.

seo.genreIntroOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {genreName} channel from around the world, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software.
seo.genreIntroOne.translated: FreeTV Garden දැනට {names} ඇතුළුව ලොව පුරා {count} සජීවී {genreName} නාලිකාව ලැයිස්තුගත කරයි — පොදු iptv-org නාලිකා නාමාවලියෙන් සජීවීව ඇද ගන්නා අතර අමතර මෘදුකාංගයක් නොමැතිව ඔබේ බ්‍රවුසරයේ ක්ෂණිකව වාදනය කළ හැක.

seo.genreIntroMany.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {genreName} channels from around the world, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} च्यानलहरू हेर्नको लागि कुनै एप वा खाता आवश्यक पर्दैन। यो पृष्ठले कुनै पनि यन्त्रमा तपाईंको ब्राउजरमा सीधै काम गर्छ - केवल च्यानल ट्याप गर्नुहोस् र प्ले थिच्नुहोस्।

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: यो पृष्ठ सफारीमा खोल्नुहोस् र तुरुन्तै स्ट्रिमिङ सुरु गर्न कुनै पनि {countryName} च्यानलमा ट्याप गर्नुहोस्। सेयर आइकनमा ट्याप गर्नुहोस् र एप स्टोरबाट एप डाउनलोड नगरिकनै एक-ट्याप पहुँचको लागि "गृह स्क्रिनमा थप्नुहोस्" चयन गर्नुहोस्।

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: यो पृष्ठ आफ्नो टिभीको निर्मित ब्राउजरमा खोल्नुहोस्, वा ठूलो स्क्रिनमा {countryName} च्यानलहरू हेर्नको लागि Chromecast वा AirPlay प्रयोग गरेर यसलाई आफ्नो फोन वा ल्यापटपबाट कास्ट गर्नुहोस्।

seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} চেনেল চাবলৈ কোনো এপ বা একাউণ্টৰ প্ৰয়োজন নাই। এই পৃষ্ঠাটোৱে যিকোনো ডিভাইচত আপোনাৰ ব্ৰাউজাৰত পোনপটীয়াকৈ কাম কৰে - মাত্ৰ এটা চেনেল টেপ কৰক আৰু প্লে টিপক।

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: এই পৃষ্ঠাটো Chrome ত খোলক, চোৱা আৰম্ভ কৰিবলৈ এটা {countryName} চেনেল টেপ কৰক, তাৰ পিছত সৰ্বোত্তম দৰ্শনৰ বাবে সম্পূৰ্ণ পৰ্দা বুটাম ব্যৱহাৰ কৰক। পৰৱৰ্তী সময়ত দ্ৰুত অভিগমৰ বাবে, Chrome মেনু টেপ কৰক আৰু এটা এপৰ দৰে আইকন সৃষ্টি কৰিবলৈ "হোম স্ক্ৰীণত যোগ কৰক" বাছক।

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: এই পৃষ্ঠাটো Safari ত খোলক আৰু যিকোনো {countryName} চেনেল টেপ কৰক যাতে তৎক্ষণাত ষ্ট্ৰীমিং আৰম্ভ হয়। শ্বেয়াৰ আইকন টেপ কৰক আৰু এপ ষ্ট'ৰৰ পৰা কোনো এপ ডাউনলোড নকৰাকৈ এক টেপ প্ৰৱেশৰ বাবে "হোম স্ক্ৰীণত যোগ কৰক" নিৰ্বাচন কৰক।

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: যিকোনো আধুনিক ব্ৰাউজাৰে কাম কৰে - ক্ৰ'ম, ছাফাৰী, ফায়াৰফক্স বা এজ। এটা {countryName} চেনেল খোলক আৰু এটা বিক্ষিপ্ততা-মুক্ত, টিভিৰ দৰে দৰ্শনৰ অভিজ্ঞতাৰ বাবে প্লেয়াৰত সম্পূৰ্ণ পৰ্দা আইকন ব্যৱহাৰ কৰক।

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: FreeTV Garden ত {countryName} টিভি চোৱাটো বিনামূলীয়া নেকি?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: হয়। FreeTV Garden এ অনলাইনত ৰাজহুৱাভাৱে উপলব্ধ ফ্ৰী-টু-এয়াৰ (FTA) চেনেলসমূহ একত্ৰিত কৰে। চাবলৈ কোনো চাবস্ক্ৰিপচন, একাউণ্ট বা এপৰ প্ৰয়োজন নাই।

seo.faqHostQ.en: Does FreeTV Garden host or upload the video streams?
seo.faqHostQ.translated: FreeTV Garden はビデオ ストリームをホストまたはアップロードしますか?

seo.faqHostA.en: No. FreeTV Garden does not host, upload or store any video files. It links to publicly available streams so you can watch them directly from the broadcaster's own servers.
seo.faqHostA.translated: いいえ、FreeTV Garden はビデオ ファイルをホスト、アップロード、または保存しません。 公開されているストリームにリンクしているので、放送局独自のサーバーから直接視聴できます。

seo.countryIntroTV.en: This page is part of {siteLink}, our free live TV tool covering 1000+ channels from 200+ countries. Here the tool opens straight to {countryName}, so you can start watching immediately in your browser - no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required.
seo.countryIntroTV.translated: このページは、200 か国以上の 1000 以上のチャンネルをカバーする無料のライブ TV ツール {siteLink} の一部です。 ここでは、ツールが {countryName} に直接開くため、サインアップ、アプリ、サブスクリプション、クレジット カードは必要なく、ブラウザーですぐに視聴を開始できます。

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: デバイスで {countryName} テレビを視聴する方法

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} チャンネルを視聴するのにアプリやアカウントは必要ありません。 このページは、どのデバイスのブラウザでも直接動作します。チャンネルをタップして再生を押すだけです。

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Chrome でこのページを開き、{countryName} チャンネルをタップして視聴を開始し、最適な表示を得るには全画面ボタンを使用してください。 次回からすばやくアクセスするには、Chrome メニューをタップし、[ホーム画面に追加] を選択してアプリのようなアイコンを作成します。

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Safari でこのページを開き、任意の {countryName} チャンネルをタップすると、すぐにストリーミングを開始できます。 共有アイコンをタップし、「ホーム画面に追加」を選択すると、App Store からアプリをダウンロードすることなく、ワンタップでアクセスできます。

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Chrome、Safari、Firefox、Edge など、最新のブラウザであればどれでも動作します。 {countryName} チャンネルを開き、プレーヤーの全画面アイコンを使用すると、気を散らすことなくテレビのような視聴体験ができます。

seo.platformSmartTV.translated: スマートテレビとFire Stick:

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: このページをテレビの内蔵ブラウザで開くか、Chromecast または AirPlay を使用して携帯電話やラップトップからキャストして、大画面で {countryName} チャンネルを視聴してください。

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: FreeTV Garden で {countryName} TV を視聴するのは無料ですか?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: はい。 FreeTV Garden は、オンラインで公開されている Free-to-Air (FTA) チャンネルを集約します。 視聴するためにサブスクリプション、アカウント、アプリは必要ありません。

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?
seo.countryFaqCountQ.translated: FreeTV Garden には {countryName} チャンネルがいくつありますか?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: 現在、 {count} ライブ チャンネルが中心で、 {categories} などのカテゴリにまたがっています。

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: チャンネル数は、パブリック ストリームがオンまたはオフラインになるにつれて頻繁に変化します。上のツールを開いて、現在のライブを確認してください。

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: このリストは、パブリック iptv-org ディレクトリから自動的に更新されます。

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: 一部の {countryName} チャネルがバッファリングされたり、ロードに失敗したりするのはなぜですか?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: 放送局自身のサーバーに直接接続しているため、速度と信頼性は私たちのインフラストラクチャではなく、放送局のインフラストラクチャに依存します。 1 つのチャンネルが読み込まれない場合は、リストから別のチャンネルを試してください。

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: はい - プレーヤーはアプリをダウンロードしなくても、どの携帯電話のブラウザでも動作します。 このページを開いてニュース チャンネルをタップし、全画面表示を使用すると最適な表示が得られます。

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: これは {countryName} 放送局の公式 Web サイトですか?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: いいえ、FreeTV Garden は、公開されているストリームにリンクする独立したディレクトリです。 このページにリストされている放送局と提携、承認、または運営されているわけではありません。

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: Тиймээ. FreeTV Garden нь онлайнаар олон нийтэд нээлттэй байдаг Free-to-Air (FTA) сувгуудыг нэгтгэдэг. Үзэхэд ямар ч захиалга, бүртгэл эсвэл апп шаардлагагүй.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?

seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: Одоогоор {categories} зэрэг категориудыг хамарсан {count} шууд сувагтай.

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: Нийтийн дамжуулалтууд офлайн болон асах үед сувгийн тоо байнга өөрчлөгддөг — яг одоо шууд дамжуулж буй зүйлийг харахын тулд дээрх хэрэгслийг нээнэ үү.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: Энэ жагсаалт нь нийтийн iptv-org лавлахаас автоматаар шинэчлэгддэг.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Зарим {countryName} сувгууд яагаад буферд ордог эсвэл ачаалж чадахгүй байна вэ?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Та нэвтрүүлэгчийн өөрийн серверт шууд холбогдож байгаа тул хурд, найдвартай байдал нь манайхаас биш тэдний дэд бүтцээс хамаарна. Хэрэв нэг суваг ачаалагдахгүй бол жагсаалтаас өөр суваг үзээрэй.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: Би утсан дээрээ {countryName} мэдээллийн сувгийг шууд үзэж болох уу?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Тиймээ - тоглуулагч нь ямар ч програм татаж авахгүйгээр утасны хөтөч дээр ажилладаг. Зүгээр л энэ хуудсыг нээж, мэдээллийн сувгийг товшоод, хамгийн сайн үзэхийн тулд бүтэн дэлгэцийг ашиглана уу.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: Энэ {countryName} өргөн нэвтрүүлгийн албан ёсны вэбсайт мөн үү?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: Үгүй. FreeTV Garden нь олон нийтэд нээлттэй урсгалуудтай холбосон бие даасан лавлах юм. Энэ хуудсан дээр жагсаасан ямар ч нэвтрүүлэгчтэй холбоогүй, дэмжигдээгүй эсвэл ажиллуулдаггүй.

seo.genreCategoryDescription.translated: འཛམ་གླིང་ས་ཕྱོགས་གང་ས་ནས་རིན་མེད་ཐོག་ཐད་གཏོང་བྱེད་པའི་{genreName}བརྙན་འཕྲིན་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ཁང་། མིང་ཐོ་འགོད་མི་དགོས། མངགས་ཉོ་བྱེད་མི་དགོས།

seo.spokenLanguageTitle.en: Watch Free {langName} Channels Online | FreeTV Garden
seo.spokenLanguageTitle.translated: དྲ་ཐོག་ནས་རིན་མེད་ཀྱི་{langName} བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ཁང་ལ་ལྟོས། རིན་མེད་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ལྡུམ་ར།

seo.spokenLanguageDescription.en: Stream free live {langName} TV channels from around the world. No signup, no subscription required.
seo.spokenLanguageDescription.translated: འཛམ་གླིང་ས་ཕྱོགས་གང་ས་ནས་རིན་མེད་ཐོག་ཐད་གཏོང་བྱེད་པའི་{langName}བརྙན་འཕྲིན་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ཁང་། མིང་ཐོ་འགོད་མི་དགོས། མངགས་ཉོ་བྱེད་མི་དགོས།

seo.wantCountryH2.en: Want channels from a specific country instead?
seo.wantCountryH2.translated: དེའི་ཚབ་ཏུ་རྒྱལ་ཁབ་གཅིག་ནས་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་དགོས་སམ།

seo.faqHostQ.en: Does FreeTV Garden host or upload the video streams?
seo.faqHostQ.translated: ཕི་རི་ཊི་ཝི་ལྡུམ་རའི་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་གྱི་རྒྱུན་ལམ་དེ་ཚོ་གཉེར་བའམ་ཡང་ན་ཡར་བསྐུར་གྱི་ཡོད་དམ།

seo.faqHostA.en: No. FreeTV Garden does not host, upload or store any video files. It links to publicly available streams so you can watch them directly from the broadcaster's own servers.
seo.faqHostA.translated: མ་རེད། ཕི་རི་ཊི་ཝི་ལྡུམ་རའི་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ཡིག་ཆ་གང་རུང་ཞིག་གཉེར་བ་དང་། ཡར་བསྐུར་བ། ཡང་ན་ཉར་ཚགས་བྱེད་ཀྱི་མེད། དེས་མི་མང་ལ་ཐོབ་ཐང་ཡོད་པའི་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ལ་འབྲེལ་མཐུད་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཡོད། དེར་བརྟེན་ཁྱེད་ཀྱིས་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ལས་ཁུངས་རང་ཉིད་ཀྱི་ཞབས་ཞུ་འཕྲུལ་ཆས་ནས་ཐད་ཀར་ལྟ་ཐུབ།

seo.faqCountNoneA.en: The count changes as streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.faqCountNoneA.translated: གློག་རྒྱུན་འགྲོ་བཞིན་པ་དང་དྲ་རྒྱ་ལས་ཕྱིར་ཐོན་པའི་སྐབས་གྲངས་ཀ་དེ་འགྱུར་བ་འགྲོ་གི་ཡོད། གོང་དུ་ཡོད་པའི་ལག་ཆ་དེ་ཁ་ཕྱེ་ནས་ད་ལྟ་གང་ཐད་གཏོང་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཡོད་མེད་ལྟོས།

seo.faqCountFromCountriesA.en: Currently around {count} live channels from {countries} countries.
seo.faqCountFromCountriesA.translated: ད་ལྟའི་ཆར་{countries} རྒྱལ་ཁབ་ཀྱི་ཐད་གཏོང་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ཁང་།

seo.countryIntroTV.en: This page is part of {siteLink}, our free live TV tool covering 1000+ channels from 200+ countries. Here the tool opens straight to {countryName}, so you can start watching immediately in your browser - no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required.
seo.countryIntroTV.translated: ཤོག་ངོས་འདི་{siteLink} ཡི་ཆ་ཤས་ཤིག་ཡིན། ང་ཚོའི་རིན་མེད་ཀྱི་ཐད་གཏོང་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ལག་ཆ་དེས་རྒྱལ་ཁབ་200ལྷག་གི་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ཁང་1000ལྷག་ཙམ་ལ་ཁྱབ་ཡོད། འདིར་ལག་ཆ་དེ་ཐད་ཀར་{countryName} ལ་ཁ་ཕྱེ། དེར་བརྟེན་ཁྱེད་ཀྱིས་དྲ་ཚིགས་ནང་དུ་འཕྲལ་མར་ལྟ་འགོ་ཚུགས་ཐུབ། ཐོ་འགོད་བྱེད་མི་དགོས། མཉེན་ཆས། མངགས་ཉོ་བྱེད་མི་དགོས།

seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.en: {countryName}'s free-to-air TV channels are pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory, covering categories like news, entertainment, sports and music where available, and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.translated: {countryName} ཡི་རིན་མེད་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་གྱི་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ཁང་དེ་ཚོ་སྤྱི་པའི་iptv-org བརྙན་འཕྲིན་གྱི་སྣོད་ཐོ་ནས་ཐད་གཏོང་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཡོད། རིན་མེད་ཀྱི་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་བསྡུ་རུབ་བྱེད་མཁན་གང་རུང་དང་འདྲ་བར། བརྙན་འཕྲིན་གྱི་ཐོ་གཞུང་ངེས་ཅན་དེ་ཉིན་རེ་བཞིན་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་འགྲོ་བཞིན་པའི་སྐབས་དང་དྲ་རྒྱའི་ཕྱི་རོལ་དུ་འགྱུར་བ་འགྲོ་སྲིད་པ་རེད།

seo.countryChannelsParagraphOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {countryName} channel, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphOne.translated: ཕི་རི་ཊི་ཝི་ལྡུམ་རའི་ད་ལྟ་{count} ཐད་གཏོང་{countryName} བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ཐོ་འགོད་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཡོད། དེའི་ནང་{names} ཡང་ཚུད་ཡོད། རིན་མེད་ཀྱི་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་བསྡུ་རུབ་བྱེད་མཁན་གང་རུང་དང་འདྲ་བར། བརྙན་འཕྲིན་གྱི་ཐོ་གཞུང་ངེས་ཅན་དེ་ཉིན་རེ་བཞིན་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་འགྲོ་བཞིན་པའི་སྐབས་དང་དྲ་རྒྱའི་ཕྱི་རོལ་དུ་འགྱུར་བ་འགྲོ་སྲིད་པ་རེད།

seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {countryName} channels, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.translated: ཕི་རི་ཊི་ཝི་ལྡུམ་རའི་ད་ལྟ་{count} ཐད་གཏོང་{countryName} བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ཐོ་འགོད་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཡོད། དེའི་ནང་{names} ཡང་ཚུད་ཡོད། རིན་མེད་ཀྱི་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་བསྡུ་རུབ་བྱེད་མཁན་གང་རུང་དང་འདྲ་བར། བརྙན་འཕྲིན་གྱི་ཐོ་གཞུང་ངེས་ཅན་དེ་ཉིན་རེ་བཞིན་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་འགྲོ་བཞིན་པའི་སྐབས་དང་དྲ་རྒྱའི་ཕྱི་རོལ་དུ་འགྱུར་བ་འགྲོ་སྲིད་པ་རེད།

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: ཁ་པར་ནང་{countryName} བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ལྟ་ཐབས།

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ལྟ་བར་མཉེན་ཆས་དང་རྩིས་ཁྲ་གང་ཡང་དགོས་ཀྱི་མེད། ཤོག་ངོས་འདི་ཁྱེད་ཀྱི་དྲ་ངོས་ནང་ལ་འཕྲུལ་ཆས་གང་རུང་ཞིག་གི་ཐོག་ལ་ཐད་ཀར་ལས་ཀ་བྱེད་ཐུབ།

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: ཤོག་ངོས་འདི་Chromeནང་དུ་ཁ་ཕྱེ་ནས་{countryName} བརྒྱུད་ལམ་ལ་ཨེབ་ནས་བལྟ་འགོ་ཚུགས་པ་དང་། དེ་ནས་མཐོང་སྣང་ཡག་ཤོས་ལ་གསལ་གཞི་ཆ་ཚང་གི་མཐེབ་བེད་སྤྱོད་བྱེད་དགོས། རྗེས་མར་མགྱོགས་པོ་འཛུལ་སྤྱོད་བྱེད་པར་Chrome དཀར་ཆག་ལ་ཨེབ་ནས་"ཁྱིམ་གྱི་གསལ་གཞི་ལ་ཁ་སྣོན་བྱེད་"ཞེས་པ་དེ་འདེམས་ནས་མཉེན་ཆས་ལྟ་བུའི་འདྲ་སྐུ་བཟོས།

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: ཤོག་ངོས་འདི་ས་ཕ་རི་ནང་ཁ་ཕྱེ་ནས་{countryName} བརྒྱུད་ལམ་གང་རུང་ལ་རྡེབ་ནས་ལམ་སེང་སྒྲོག་སྤེལ་བྱེད་འགོ་ཚུགས། བརྗེ་རེས་བྱེད་པའི་འདྲ་སྐུ་ལ་ཨེབ་ནས་མཉེན་ཆས་ཚོང་ཁང་ནས་མཉེན་ཆས་ཕབ་ལེན་མ་བྱེད་པར་གཅིག་རྐྱང་གིས་འཛུལ་ཐུབ་པའི་ཆེད་དུ་"ཁྱིམ་གྱི་གསལ་གཞི་ལ་ཁ་སྣོན་"ཞེས་པ་དེ་འདེམས་དགོས།

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: དེང་རབས་ཀྱི་དྲ་ལྗོངས་གང་རུང་ཞིག་གིས་ཁི་རོམ་དང་། ས་ཕ་རི། ཕ་ཡར་ཕོགས། ཡང་ན་ཨེ་ཇི། {countryName} བརྒྱུད་ལམ་ཁ་ཕྱེ་ནས་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ལྟ་བུའི་ལྟ་བའི་ཉམས་མྱོང་ལ་བར་ཆད་མེད་པའི་ཆེད་དུ་སྒྲ་སྒམ་ནང་དུ་ཡོད་པའི་གློག་བརྙན་ཆ་ཚང་གི་འདྲ་སྐུ་དེ་བེད་སྤྱོད་བྱོས།

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: ཤོག་ངོས་འདི་ཁྱེད་རང་གི་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་གྱི་ནང་དུ་ཡོད་པའི་དྲ་ངོས་ནང་ཁ་ཕྱེ་བའམ་ཡང་ན་ཁྱེད་རང་གི་ཁ་པར་དང་གློག་ཀླད་ནས་Chromecast ཡང་ན་ AirPlay བཀོལ་ནས་གློག་བརྙན་ཆེན་པོའི་སྟེང་དུ་{countryName} བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ལྟ་དགོས།

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: {homeLink} ལ་ལོག་ནས་བརྗེ་རེས་བྱེད་ཐུབ་པའི་3D འཛམ་གླིང་འདི་འཁོར་ནས་ང་ཚོས་རྒྱབ་སྐྱོར་བྱེད་པའི་རྒྱལ་ཁབ་200ལྷག་ཙམ་འདེམས་པའམ་ཡང་ན་{countriesLink} ལ་ལྟ་ཞིབ་བྱོས།

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: ཕི་རི་ཊི་ཝི་ལྡུམ་རའི་ནང་{countryName} བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ལྟ་རྒྱུ་རིན་མེད་ཡིན་ནམ།

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: ཡིན། ཕི་རི་ཊི་ཝི་ལྡུམ་རའི་དྲ་ཐོག་ནས་སྤྱི་དམངས་ལ་ཐོབ་ཐུབ་པའི་རིན་མེད་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་(FTA)བསྡུ་རུབ་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཡོད། བལྟ་བར་མངགས་ཉོ་དང་། རྩིས་ཁྲ། ཡང་ན་མཉེན་ཆས་དགོས་མཁོ་མེད།

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: ད་ལྟའི་ཆར་{count} ཐད་གཏོང་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་གྱི་མཐའ་འཁོར་དུ་ཡོད། དེ་དག་གིས་{categories} ལྟ་བུའི་སྡེ་ཚན་ལ་ཁྱབ་ཡོད།

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: སྤྱི་དམངས་ཀྱི་རྒྱུན་ལམ་འགྲོ་བཞིན་པའི་སྐབས་དང་དྲ་རྒྱའི་ཕྱི་རོལ་དུ་འགྲོ་བའི་སྐབས་བརྡ་འཕྲིན་གྱི་གྲངས་འབོར་ཡང་ཡང་འགྱུར་བ་འགྲོ་གི་ཡོད།

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: ཐོ་འདི་སྤྱི་པའི་iptv-orgསྣོད་ཐོ་ནས་རང་འགུལ་གྱིས་ཁ་སྐོང་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཡོད།

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: ཅིའི་ཕྱིར་{countryName} རྒྱུད་ལམ་ཁ་ཤས་བར་སྟོང་ཡིན་པའམ་ཡང་ན་མངོན་ཐུབ་ཀྱི་མེད།

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: ཁྱེད་རང་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ལས་ཁུངས་རང་ཉིད་ཀྱི་ཞབས་ཞུ་འཕྲུལ་ཆས་ལ་ཐད་ཀར་མཐུད་ཀྱི་ཡོད། དེར་བརྟེན་མགྱོགས་ཚད་དང་བློ་གཏད་ཆོག་ཚད་དེ་ང་ཚོའི་རྨང་གཞིའི་སྒྲིག་བཀོད་ལ་རག་སླེབས་ཀྱི་མེད། གལ་ཏེ་རྒྱུ་ལམ་གཅིག་མངོན་མི་ཐུབ་ན། ཐོ་གཞུང་ནས་གཞན་ཞིག་ཚོད་ལྟ་བྱོས།

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: ངས་ཁ་པར་ཐོག་ནས་{countryName} གསར་འགྱུར་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ཐད་གཏོང་ལྟ་ཐུབ་བམ།

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: རེད། གླུ་གཞས་དེ་མཉེན་ཆས་ཕབ་ལེན་མེད་པའི་ཁ་པར་དྲ་ངོས་གང་རུང་ཞིག་གི་སྟེང་ལ་ལས་ཀ་བྱེད་ཐུབ། ཤོག་ངོས་འདི་ཁ་ཕྱེ་ནས་གསར་འགྱུར་གྱི་བརྒྱུད་ལམ་ལ་རྡེབ་ནས་མཐོང་སྣང་ཡག་ཤོས་ལ་གློག་བརྙན་ཆ་ཚང་བེད་སྤྱོད་བྱོས།

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: འདི་ནི་{countryName} བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ལས་ཁུངས་གང་རུང་གི་གཞུང་འབྲེལ་དྲ་ཚིགས་ཡིན་ནམ།

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: མ་རེད། ཕི་རི་ཊི་ཝི་ལྡུམ་ར་ནི་སྤྱི་དམངས་ལ་ཐོབ་པའི་རྒྱུན་ལམ་ལ་འབྲེལ་མཐུད་བྱེད་པའི་རང་དབང་གི་སྣོད་ཐོ་ཞིག་ཡིན། ཤོག་ངོས་འདིའི་ཐོག་ཐོ་འགོད་བྱས་པའི་རླུང་འཕྲིན་ལས་ཁུངས་གང་རུང་དང་འབྲེལ་བ་མེད་པ་དང་།

seo.genreIntroOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {genreName} channel from around the world, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software.
seo.genreIntroOne.translated: ཕི་རི་ཊི་ཝི་ལྡུམ་རའི་ད་ལྟ་འཛམ་གླིང་ཡོངས་ཀྱི་{count} ཐད་གཏོང་{genreName} བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ཐོ་འགོད་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཡོད། དེའི་ནང་{names} ཡང་ཚུད་ཡོད།

seo.genreIntroMany.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {genreName} channels from around the world, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software.
seo.genreIntroMany.translated: ཕི་རི་ཊི་ཝི་ལྡུམ་རའི་ད་ལྟ་འཛམ་གླིང་ཡོངས་ཀྱི་{count} ཐད་གཏོང་{genreName} བརྙན་འཕྲིན་ཐོ་འགོད་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཡོད། དེའི་ནང་{names} ཡང་ཚུད་ཡོད།

seo.genreIntroEmpty.en: {genreName} channels on FreeTV Garden are pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. The exact channel list changes day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.genreIntroEmpty.translated: {genreName} ཕི་རི་ཊི་ཝི་ལྡུམ་རའི་ཐོག་གི་བརྙན་འཕྲིན་དེ་ཚོ་སྤྱི་པའི་iptv-orgབརྙན་འཕྲིན་གྱི་སྣོད་ཐོ་ནས་ཐད་གཏོང་བྱེད་པ་དང་མཉེན་ཆས་ཁ་སྣོན་མེད་པར་ཁྱེད་ཀྱི་དྲ་ཚིགས་ནང་ལ་འཕྲལ་མར་གཏོང་ཐུབ། བརྙན་འཕྲིན་གྱི་ཐོ་གཞུང་ངེས་ཅན་དེ་ཉིན་རེ་བཞིན་འགྱུར་བ་འགྲོ་གི་ཡོད།

seo.genreBrowseP.en: Browse the {countriesLink}, or head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive globe.
seo.genreBrowseP.translated: {countriesLink} ལ་ལྟ་ཞིབ་བྱེད་པའམ་ཡང་ན་ {homeLink} ལ་ལོག་ནས་བརྗེ་རེས་བྱེད་པའི་འཛམ་གླིང་འདི་འཁོར་བར་བྱོས།

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: Xem {countryName} TV trên FreeTV Garden có miễn phí không?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: Đúng. FreeTV Garden tổng hợp các kênh Free-to-Air (FTA) được cung cấp công khai trực tuyến. Không cần đăng ký, tài khoản hoặc ứng dụng để xem.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Tại sao một số kênh {countryName} bị đệm hoặc không tải được?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Bạn đang kết nối trực tiếp với máy chủ của đài truyền hình, vì vậy tốc độ và độ tin cậy phụ thuộc vào cơ sở hạ tầng của họ chứ không phải của chúng tôi. Nếu một kênh không tải, hãy thử kênh khác từ danh sách.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: Tôi có thể xem trực tiếp các kênh tin tức {countryName} trên điện thoại của mình không?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Có — trình phát hoạt động trên mọi trình duyệt điện thoại mà không cần tải xuống ứng dụng. Chỉ cần mở trang này, nhấn vào kênh tin tức và sử dụng chế độ toàn màn hình để có chế độ xem tốt nhất.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: Đây có phải là trang web chính thức của bất kỳ đài truyền hình {countryName} nào không?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: Không. FreeTV Garden là một thư mục độc lập liên kết với các luồng có sẵn công khai. Nó không được liên kết, xác nhận hoặc vận hành bởi bất kỳ đài truyền hình nào được liệt kê trên trang này.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: Paano manood ng {countryName} TV sa iyong device

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Walang app o account ang kailangan para manood ng {countryName} na mga channel. Direktang gumagana ang page na ito sa iyong browser sa anumang device - i-tap lang ang isang channel at pindutin ang play.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Buksan ang page na ito sa Chrome, i-tap ang isang {countryName} channel para magsimulang manood, pagkatapos ay gamitin ang fullscreen na button para sa pinakamagandang view. Para sa mabilis na pag-access sa susunod, i-tap ang menu ng Chrome at piliin ang "Idagdag sa Home Screen" para gumawa ng icon na parang app.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Buksan ang page na ito sa Safari at i-tap ang anumang {countryName} na channel upang agad na magsimulang mag-stream. I-tap ang icon ng Ibahagi at piliin ang "Idagdag sa Home Screen" para sa isang pag-tap na access nang hindi nagda-download ng app mula sa App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Gumagana ang anumang modernong browser - Chrome, Safari, Firefox o Edge. Magbukas ng {countryName} channel at gamitin ang fullscreen na icon sa player para sa walang distraction, parang TV na karanasan sa panonood.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Buksan ang page na ito sa built-in na browser ng iyong TV, o i-cast ito mula sa iyong telepono o laptop gamit ang Chromecast o AirPlay upang manood ng {countryName} na mga channel sa malaking screen.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: Libre ba ang panonood ng {countryName} TV sa FreeTV Garden?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: Oo. Pinagsasama-sama ng FreeTV Garden ang mga Free-to-Air (FTA) na channel na available sa publiko online. Walang kinakailangang subscription, account o app para mapanood.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Bakit ang ilang {countryName} channel ay buffer o hindi naglo-load?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Direkta kang kumokonekta sa sariling server ng broadcaster, kaya ang bilis at pagiging maaasahan ay nakasalalay sa kanilang imprastraktura, hindi sa amin. Kung hindi naglo-load ang isang channel, subukan ang isa pa mula sa listahan.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: របៀបមើលទូរទស្សន៍ {countryName} នៅលើឧបករណ៍របស់អ្នក។

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: មិនចាំបាច់មានកម្មវិធី ឬគណនីដើម្បីមើលប៉ុស្តិ៍ {countryName} ទេ។ ទំព័រនេះដំណើរការដោយផ្ទាល់នៅក្នុងកម្មវិធីរុករកតាមអ៊ីនធឺណិតរបស់អ្នកនៅលើឧបករណ៍ណាមួយ - គ្រាន់តែប៉ះឆានែលមួយហើយចុចលេង។

seo.platformAndroid.translated: ប្រព័ន្ធប្រតិបត្តិការ Android៖

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: បើកទំព័រនេះនៅក្នុង Chrome ចុចឆានែល {countryName} ដើម្បីចាប់ផ្តើមមើល បន្ទាប់មកប្រើប៊ូតុងពេញអេក្រង់សម្រាប់ការមើលដ៏ល្អបំផុត។ សម្រាប់ការចូលប្រើរហ័សនៅពេលក្រោយ សូមចុចលើម៉ឺនុយ Chrome ហើយជ្រើសរើស "បន្ថែមទៅអេក្រង់ដើម" ដើម្បីបង្កើតរូបតំណាងដូចកម្មវិធី។

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: បើកទំព័រនេះនៅក្នុង Safari ហើយប៉ះឆានែល {countryName} ណាមួយដើម្បីចាប់ផ្តើមការផ្សាយភ្លាមៗ។ ប៉ះរូបតំណាងចែករំលែក ហើយជ្រើសរើស "បន្ថែមទៅអេក្រង់ដើម" សម្រាប់ការចូលប្រើដោយចុចតែម្តង ដោយមិនចាំបាច់ទាញយកកម្មវិធីពី App Store ។

seo.platformDesktop.translated: កុំព្យូទ័រ និង Mac៖

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: កម្មវិធីរុករកទំនើបណាមួយដំណើរការ - Chrome, Safari, Firefox ឬ Edge ។ បើកប៉ុស្តិ៍ {countryName} ហើយប្រើរូបតំណាងពេញអេក្រង់នៅក្នុងកម្មវិធីចាក់ ដើម្បីទទួលបានបទពិសោធន៍មើលដូចទូរទស្សន៍គ្មានការរំខាន។

seo.platformSmartTV.translated: ទូរទស្សន៍ Smart TV និង Fire Stick៖

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: បើកទំព័រនេះនៅក្នុងកម្មវិធីរុករកតាមអ៊ីនធឺណិតដែលភ្ជាប់មកជាមួយទូរទស្សន៍របស់អ្នក ឬបោះវាចេញពីទូរសព្ទ ឬកុំព្យូទ័រយួរដៃរបស់អ្នកដោយប្រើ Chromecast ឬ AirPlay ដើម្បីមើលប៉ុស្តិ៍ {countryName} នៅលើអេក្រង់ធំ។

seo.countryAnotherH2.translated: ចង់បានប៉ុស្តិ៍ពីប្រទេសផ្សេងទេ?

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: ត្រលប់ទៅ {homeLink} ដើម្បីបង្វិលពិភពលោក 3D អន្តរកម្ម ហើយជ្រើសរើសប្រទេសណាមួយក្នុងចំណោម 200+ ប្រទេសដែលយើងគាំទ្រ ឬរុករក {countriesLink} ។

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: តើការមើលទូរទស្សន៍ {countryName} នៅលើ FreeTV Garden ឥតគិតថ្លៃទេ?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: បាទ។ FreeTV Garden ប្រមូលផ្តុំបណ្តាញ Free-to-Air (FTA) ដែលមានជាសាធារណៈតាមអ៊ីនធឺណិត។ មិនចាំបាច់ជាវ គណនី ឬកម្មវិធីដើម្បីមើលទេ។

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?
seo.countryFaqCountQ.translated: តើ FreeTV Garden មានប៉ុស្តិ៍ {countryName} ប៉ុន្មាន?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: បច្ចុប្បន្ននៅជុំវិញ {count} ឆានែលបន្តផ្ទាល់ វិសាលភាពប្រភេទដូចជា {categories} ។

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: ចំនួនឆានែលផ្លាស់ប្តូរជាញឹកញាប់នៅពេលដែលការផ្សាយជាសាធារណៈបន្ត និងក្រៅបណ្តាញ — បើកឧបករណ៍ខាងលើដើម្បីមើលអ្វីដែលកំពុងផ្សាយបន្តផ្ទាល់ឥឡូវនេះ។

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: បញ្ជីនេះធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាពដោយស្វ័យប្រវត្តិពីថត iptv-org សាធារណៈ។

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: ហេតុអ្វីបានជាឆានែល {countryName} មួយចំនួនមានសតិបណ្ដោះអាសន្ន ឬបរាជ័យក្នុងការផ្ទុក?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: អ្នកកំពុងភ្ជាប់ដោយផ្ទាល់ទៅម៉ាស៊ីនមេរបស់អ្នកផ្សាយផ្ទាល់ ដូច្នេះល្បឿន និងភាពជឿជាក់អាស្រ័យលើហេដ្ឋារចនាសម្ព័ន្ធរបស់វា មិនមែនជារបស់យើងទេ។ ប្រសិនបើឆានែលមួយមិនផ្ទុកទេ សូមសាកល្បងមួយទៀតពីបញ្ជី។

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?

seo.faqHostQ.en: Does FreeTV Garden host or upload the video streams?
seo.faqHostQ.translated: FreeTV Garden ເປັນເຈົ້າພາບ ຫຼື ອັບໂຫຼດວິດີໂອສະຕຣີມບໍ່?

seo.faqHostA.en: No. FreeTV Garden does not host, upload or store any video files. It links to publicly available streams so you can watch them directly from the broadcaster's own servers.
seo.faqHostA.translated: ບໍ່. FreeTV Garden ບໍ່ໄດ້ເປັນເຈົ້າພາບ, ອັບໂຫຼດ ຫຼືເກັບຮັກສາໄຟລ໌ວິດີໂອໃດໆ. ມັນເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ກັບການຖ່າຍທອດສາທາລະນະເພື່ອໃຫ້ທ່ານສາມາດເບິ່ງພວກມັນໄດ້ໂດຍກົງຈາກເຊີບເວີຂອງຜູ້ອອກອາກາດເອງ.

seo.countryIntroTV.en: This page is part of {siteLink}, our free live TV tool covering 1000+ channels from 200+ countries. Here the tool opens straight to {countryName}, so you can start watching immediately in your browser - no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required.

As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.translated: ຊ່ອງໂທລະພາບຟຣີຂອງ {countryName} ໄດ້ຖືກດຶງອອກມາຈາກຊ່ອງ iptv-org ສາທາລະນະ, ກວມເອົາໝວດໝູ່ເຊັ່ນຂ່າວ, ຄວາມບັນເທີງ, ກິລາ ແລະເພງທີ່ມີໃຫ້, ແລະສາມາດຫຼິ້ນໄດ້ທັນທີໃນໂປຣແກຣມທ່ອງເວັບຂອງທ່ານໂດຍບໍ່ມີຊອບແວເພີ່ມເຕີມ. ເຊັ່ນດຽວກັບຕົວຮວບຮວມແບບຟຣີຫາ-ອາກາດ, ລາຍຊື່ຊ່ອງທີ່ແນ່ນອນສາມາດປ່ຽນມື້ຕໍ່ວັນໄດ້ເນື່ອງຈາກການຖ່າຍທອດສົດຕໍ່ ແລະອອບລາຍ.
