seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: ບໍ່ຈຳເປັນຕ້ອງໃຊ້ແອັບ ຫຼືບັນຊີເພື່ອເບິ່ງ {countryName} ຊ່ອງ. ຫນ້ານີ້ເຮັດວຽກໂດຍກົງໃນຕົວທ່ອງເວັບຂອງທ່ານໃນອຸປະກອນໃດກໍ່ຕາມ - ພຽງແຕ່ແຕະຊ່ອງແລະກົດຫຼິ້ນ.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: ເປີດໜ້ານີ້ໃນ Chrome, ແຕະຊ່ອງ {countryName} ເພື່ອເລີ່ມການເບິ່ງ, ຈາກນັ້ນໃຊ້ປຸ່ມເຕັມຈໍເພື່ອການເບິ່ງທີ່ດີທີ່ສຸດ. ສໍາລັບການເຂົ້າເຖິງດ່ວນໃນຄັ້ງຕໍ່ໄປ, ແຕະທີ່ເມນູ Chrome ແລະເລືອກ "ເພີ່ມໃສ່ໜ້າຈໍຫຼັກ" ເພື່ອສ້າງໄອຄອນທີ່ຄ້າຍຄືກັບແອັບຯ.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: ເປີດໜ້ານີ້ໃນ Safari ແລະແຕະຊ່ອງ {countryName} ໃດກໍໄດ້ເພື່ອເລີ່ມການຖ່າຍທອດທັນທີ. ແຕະທີ່ໄອຄອນ Share ແລະເລືອກ "Add to Home Screen" ສໍາລັບການເຂົ້າເຖິງຫນຶ່ງແຕະໂດຍບໍ່ຕ້ອງດາວໂຫລດແອັບຯຈາກ App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: ທຸກຕົວທ່ອງເວັບທີ່ທັນສະໄຫມເຮັດວຽກ - Chrome, Safari, Firefox ຫຼື Edge. ເປີດຊ່ອງ {countryName} ແລະໃຊ້ໄອຄອນເຕັມຈໍໃນເຄື່ອງຫຼິ້ນເພື່ອປະສົບການການເບິ່ງແບບໂທລະພາບແບບບໍ່ມີສິ່ງລົບກວນ.

seo.platformSmartTV.translated: Smart TV ແລະ Fire Stick:

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: ເປີດໜ້ານີ້ຢູ່ໃນໂປຣແກຣມທ່ອງເວັບໃນຕົວຂອງໂທລະທັດຂອງທ່ານ, ຫຼືສົ່ງສັນຍານຈາກໂທລະສັບ ຫຼືແລັບທັອບຂອງທ່ານໂດຍໃຊ້ Chromecast ຫຼື AirPlay ເພື່ອເບິ່ງຊ່ອງ {countryName} ໃນໜ້າຈໍໃຫຍ່.

seo.countryAnotherH2.translated: ຕ້ອງການຊ່ອງຈາກປະເທດອື່ນບໍ?

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: ກັບຄືນໄປຫາ {homeLink} ເພື່ອໝຸນໂລກ 3D ແບບໂຕ້ຕອບ ແລະເລືອກອັນໃດກໍໄດ້ຈາກ 200+ ປະເທດທີ່ພວກເຮົາຮອງຮັບ, ຫຼືເລືອກເບິ່ງ {countriesLink} .

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: ເບິ່ງໂທລະພາບ {countryName} ຢູ່ FreeTV Garden ໄດ້ຟຣີບໍ?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: ແມ່ນແລ້ວ. FreeTV Garden ລວບລວມຊ່ອງຟຣີຫາອາກາດ (FTA) ທີ່ມີໃຫ້ສາທາລະນະອອນໄລນ໌. ບໍ່ມີການສະໝັກໃຊ້, ບັນຊີ ຫຼື ແອັບທີ່ຕ້ອງການເພື່ອເບິ່ງ.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?
seo.countryFaqCountQ.translated: FreeTV Garden ມີຊ່ອງ {countryName} ເທົ່າໃດ?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: ໃນປັດຈຸບັນປະມານ {count} ຊ່ອງສົດ, ກວມເອົາປະເພດເຊັ່ນ {categories} .

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: ການນັບຊ່ອງມີການປ່ຽນແປງເລື້ອຍໆເມື່ອການຖ່າຍທອດສາທາລະນະຕໍ່ ແລະອອຟລາຍ — ເປີດເຄື່ອງມືຂ້າງເທິງເພື່ອເບິ່ງສິ່ງທີ່ມີຊີວິດຢູ່ໃນຕອນນີ້.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: ບັນຊີລາຍຊື່ນີ້ປັບປຸງອັດຕະໂນມັດຈາກໄດເລກະທໍລີ iptv-org ສາທາລະນະ.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: ເປັນຫຍັງບາງຊ່ອງ {countryName} ຈື່ງມີບັຟ ຫຼືໂຫຼດບໍ່ໄດ້?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: ທ່ານກໍາລັງເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ໂດຍກົງກັບເຄື່ອງແມ່ຂ່າຍຂອງຕົນເອງຂອງຜູ້ອອກອາກາດ, ດັ່ງນັ້ນຄວາມໄວແລະຄວາມຫນ້າເຊື່ອຖືແມ່ນຂຶ້ນກັບໂຄງສ້າງພື້ນຖານຂອງພວກເຂົາ, ບໍ່ແມ່ນຂອງພວກເຮົາ. ຖ້າຊ່ອງໜຶ່ງບໍ່ໂຫຼດ, ໃຫ້ລອງອີກຊ່ອງໜຶ່ງຈາກລາຍການ.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: ຂ້ອຍສາມາດເບິ່ງ {countryName} ຊ່ອງຂ່າວສົດຢູ່ໃນໂທລະສັບຂອງຂ້ອຍໄດ້ບໍ?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: ແມ່ນແລ້ວ — ຜູ້ນເຮັດວຽກຢູ່ໃນທຸກຕົວທ່ອງເວັບຂອງໂທລະສັບໂດຍບໍ່ມີການດາວໂຫຼດ app. ພຽງ​ແຕ່​ເປີດ​ຫນ້າ​ນີ້​, ແຕະ​ຊ່ອງ​ຂ່າວ​, ແລະ​ນໍາ​ໃຊ້​ເຕັມ​ຫນ້າ​ຈໍ​ສໍາ​ລັບ​ການ​ເບິ່ງ​ທີ່​ດີ​ທີ່​ສຸດ​.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: ນີ້ແມ່ນເວັບໄຊທ໌ທາງການຂອງ {countryName} ວິທະຍຸກະຈາຍສຽງບໍ?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: ບໍ່. FreeTV Garden ເປັນໄດເລກະທໍລີເອກະລາດທີ່ເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ກັບການຖ່າຍທອດສາທາລະນະ. ມັນບໍ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງກັບ, ຮັບຮອງໂດຍ, ຫຼືດໍາເນີນການໂດຍຜູ້ອອກອາກາດໃດໆທີ່ມີລາຍຊື່ຢູ່ໃນຫນ້ານີ້.

seo.genreIntroOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {genreName} channel from around the world, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software.
seo.genreIntroOne.translated: ປະຈຸບັນ FreeTV Garden ລາຍຊື່ {count} ຊ່ອງ {genreName} ສົດຈາກທົ່ວໂລກ, ລວມທັງ {names} — ດຶງອອກສົດຈາກໄດເຣັກທໍຣີຊ່ອງ iptv-org ສາທາລະນະ ແລະສາມາດຫຼິ້ນໄດ້ທັນທີໃນໂປຣແກຣມທ່ອງເວັບຂອງທ່ານໂດຍບໍ່ມີຊອບແວເພີ່ມເຕີມ.

seo.genreIntroMany.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {genreName} channels from around the world, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software.
seo.genreIntroMany.translated: ປະຈຸບັນ FreeTV Garden ລາຍຊື່ {count} ຊ່ອງ {genreName} ສົດຈາກທົ່ວໂລກ, ລວມທັງ {names} — ດຶງອອກມາຈາກຊ່ອງ iptv-org ສາທາລະນະ ແລະສາມາດຫຼິ້ນໄດ້ທັນທີໃນໂປຣແກຣມທ່ອງເວັບຂອງທ່ານໂດຍບໍ່ມີຊອບແວເພີ່ມເຕີມ.

seo.genreIntroEmpty.en: {genreName} channels on FreeTV Garden are pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. The exact channel list changes day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.genreIntroEmpty.translated: {genreName} ຊ່ອງໃນ FreeTV Garden ໄດ້ຖືກດຶງອອກມາສົດໆຈາກໄດເລກະທໍລີຊ່ອງ iptv-org ສາທາລະນະ ແລະສາມາດຫຼິ້ນໄດ້ທັນທີໃນໂປຣແກຣມທ່ອງເວັບຂອງທ່ານໂດຍບໍ່ມີຊອບແວເພີ່ມເຕີມ. ລາຍຊື່ຊ່ອງທີ່ແນ່ນອນປ່ຽນແປງມື້ຕໍ່ວັນເນື່ອງຈາກການຖ່າຍທອດອອກສູ່ອິນເຕີເນັດ ແລະອອບລາຍ.

seo.countryChannelsParagraphOne.translated: ፍሪቲቪ ጋርደን በአሁኑ ጊዜ {names}ን ጨምሮ {count} የቀጥታ {countryName} ቻናል ይዘረዝራል — ከሕዝብ የiptv-org ቻናል ማውጫ በቀጥታ የተወሰደ እና ምንም ተጨማሪ ሶፍትዌር ሳይኖር በአሳሽዎ ውስጥ ወዲያውኑ መጫወት ይችላል። ልክ እንደ ማንኛውም ከአየር ወደ አየር ማሰባሰብያ፣ ዥረቶች ሲቀጥሉ እና ከመስመር ውጭ ሲሄዱ ትክክለኛው የሰርጥ ዝርዝር ከቀን ወደ ቀን ሊቀየር ይችላል።

seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {countryName} channels, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.translated: ፍሪቲቪ ጋርደን በአሁኑ ጊዜ {names}ን ጨምሮ {count} የቀጥታ {countryName} ቻናሎችን ይዘረዝራል — ከሕዝብ የiptv-org ቻናል ማውጫ በቀጥታ የተቀዳ እና ያለምንም ተጨማሪ ሶፍትዌር በአሳሽዎ ውስጥ ወዲያውኑ መጫወት ይችላል። ልክ እንደ ማንኛውም ከአየር ወደ አየር ማሰባሰብያ፣ ዥረቶች ሲቀጥሉ እና ከመስመር ውጭ ሲሄዱ ትክክለኛው የሰርጥ ዝርዝር ከቀን ወደ ቀን ሊቀየር ይችላል።

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: በመሳሪያዎ ላይ {countryName} ቲቪን እንዴት እንደሚመለከቱ

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} ቻናሎችን ለመመልከት ምንም መተግበሪያ ወይም መለያ አያስፈልግም። ይህ ገጽ በማንኛውም መሳሪያ ላይ በቀጥታ በአሳሽዎ ውስጥ ይሰራል - ቻናልን መታ ያድርጉ እና ተጫወትን ይጫኑ።

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: ይህንን ገጽ በChrome ውስጥ ይክፈቱ፣ ማየት ለመጀመር {countryName} ቻናል ይንኩ፣ ከዚያ ለበለጠ እይታ የሙሉ ስክሪን አዝራሩን ይጠቀሙ። በሚቀጥለው ጊዜ ለፈጣን መዳረሻ የChrome ምናሌውን መታ ያድርጉ እና መተግበሪያን የሚመስል አዶ ለመፍጠር «ወደ መነሻ ስክሪን አክል»ን ይምረጡ።

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: በቅጽበት መልቀቅ ለመጀመር ይህን ገጽ በSafari ይክፈቱ እና ማንኛውንም {countryName} ቻናል ይንኩ። አፕ ከ አፕ ስቶር ሳያወርዱ አንድ ጊዜ መታ ለማድረግ የማጋራት አዶውን ይንኩ እና "ወደ መነሻ ስክሪን አክል" ን ይምረጡ።

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: ማንኛውም ዘመናዊ አሳሽ ይሰራል - Chrome፣ Safari፣ Firefox ወይም Edge። የ {countryName} ቻናል ይክፈቱ እና የሙሉ ስክሪን አዶውን ከማስተጓጎል ነፃ የሆነ፣ ቲቪ ለሚመስል የእይታ ተሞክሮ በተጫዋቹ ውስጥ ይጠቀሙ።

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: በትልቁ ስክሪን ላይ የ{countryName} ቻናሎችን ለመመልከት ይህን ገጽ በቲቪዎ አብሮ በተሰራው አሳሽ ይክፈቱት ወይም Chromecast ወይም AirPlayን ተጠቅመው ከስልክዎ ወይም ከላፕቶፕዎ ይውሰዱት።

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: በይነተገናኝ 3D ግሎብ ለማሽከርከር ወደ {homeLink} ይመለሱ እና ከምንደግፋቸው 200+ ሀገራት አንዱን ይምረጡ ወይም {countriesLink}ን ያስሱ።

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: FreeTV Garden ላይ {countryName} ቲቪ ማየት ነጻ ነው?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: አዎ። ፍሪቲቪ አትክልት ከነጻ ወደ አየር (ኤፍቲኤ) በመስመር ላይ በይፋ የሚገኙ ቻናሎችን ይሰበስባል። ለመመልከት የሚያስፈልገው ምንም የደንበኝነት ምዝገባ፣ መለያ ወይም መተግበሪያ የለም።

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: በአሁኑ ጊዜ በ{count} የቀጥታ ቻናሎች ዙሪያ፣ እንደ {categories} ያሉ ምድቦችን ያቀፉ።

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: ይፋዊ ዥረቶች ሲቀጥሉ እና ከመስመር ውጭ በሚሄዱበት ጊዜ የሰርጡ ቆጠራ ብዙ ጊዜ ይቀየራል - አሁን በቀጥታ ምን እንዳለ ለማየት ከላይ ያለውን መሳሪያ ይክፈቱ።

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: ይህ ዝርዝር ከህዝባዊ iptv-org ማውጫ በቀጥታ ይዘምናል።

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: ለምንድነው አንዳንድ {countryName} ቻናሎች የሚቋቋሙት ወይም መጫን ያልቻሉት?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: እርስዎ በቀጥታ የሚገናኙት ከብሮድካስተር የራሱ አገልጋይ ጋር ነው፣ ስለዚህ ፍጥነት እና አስተማማኝነት በእኛ ሳይሆን በመሠረተ ልማት ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው። አንዱ ቻናል ካልተጫነ ከዝርዝሩ ውስጥ ሌላውን ይሞክሩ።

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: በስልኬ የ{countryName} የዜና ጣቢያዎችን በቀጥታ ማየት እችላለሁ?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: አዎ — ተጫዋቹ ምንም መተግበሪያ ሳይወርድ በማንኛውም የስልክ አሳሽ ላይ ይሰራል። በቀላሉ ይህንን ገጽ ይክፈቱ፣ የዜና ጣቢያን ይንኩ እና ለበለጠ እይታ ሙሉ ስክሪን ይጠቀሙ።

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: ይህ የማንኛውም {countryName} አሰራጭ ኦፊሴላዊ ድር ጣቢያ ነው?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: ፍሪቲቪ አትክልት በይፋ ከሚገኙ ዥረቶች ጋር የሚያገናኝ ገለልተኛ ማውጫ ነው። በዚህ ገፅ ላይ በተዘረዘረው ማንኛውም አሰራጭ ጋር አልተገናኘም፣ አልተደገፈም ወይም አይሰራም።

seo.genreIntroOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {genreName} channel from around the world, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software.

seo.genreIntroEmpty.en: {genreName} channels on FreeTV Garden are pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. The exact channel list changes day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.genreIntroEmpty.translated: {genreName} በፍሪቲቪ ገነት ላይ ያሉ ቻናሎች ከህዝባዊ የiptv-org ቻናል ማውጫ በቀጥታ ተስበው ያለምንም ተጨማሪ ሶፍትዌር በአሳሽዎ ውስጥ ወዲያውኑ መጫወት ይችላሉ። ዥረቶች ሲቀጥሉ እና ከመስመር ውጭ ሲሄዱ ትክክለኛው የሰርጥ ዝርዝር ከቀን ወደ ቀን ይለወጣል።

seo.genreBrowseP.en: Browse the {countriesLink}, or head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive globe.
seo.genreBrowseP.translated: በይነተገናኝ ግሎብን ለማሽከርከር {countriesLink}ን ያስሱ ወይም ወደ {homeLink} ይመለሱ።

seo.spokenLanguageIntroEmpty.translated: {langName}-kanale op FreeTV Garden word regstreeks uit die publieke iptv-org-kanaalgids getrek en kan onmiddellik in jou blaaier gespeel word sonder ekstra sagteware. Die presiese kanaallys verander van dag tot dag soos strome aan en vanlyn gaan.

seo.spokenLanguageBrowseP.en: Browse the {countriesLink}, the {languagesLink}, or head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive globe.
seo.spokenLanguageBrowseP.translated: Blaai deur die {countriesLink} , die {languagesLink} , of gaan terug na die {homeLink} om die interaktiewe aardbol te draai.

seo.spokenLanguageFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {langName}-language TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.spokenLanguageFaqFreeQ.translated: Is dit gratis om {langName}-taal-TV op FreeTV Garden te kyk?

seo.spokenLanguageFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online, regardless of which country they broadcast from. There is no subscription, account or app required.
seo.spokenLanguageFaqFreeA.translated: Ja. FreeTV Garden versamel Free-to-Air (FTA) kanale wat publiek aanlyn beskikbaar is, ongeag van watter land hulle uitsaai. Daar is geen intekening, rekening of toepassing nodig nie.

ui.showingScroll.en: Showing {shown} of {total} - scroll for more or type a name to search all
ui.showingScroll.translated: Wys tans {shown} van {total} - blaai vir meer of tik 'n naam om almal te soek

ui.showingType.en: Showing {shown} of {total} - type a name to search all
ui.showingType.translated: Wys tans {shown} van {total} - tik 'n naam om almal te soek

ui.noFavoritesYet.en: No favorites yet. Tap the ☆ on any channel to save it here.
ui.noFavoritesYet.translated: Nog geen gunstelinge nie. Tik die ☆ op enige kanaal om dit hier te stoor.

ui.noRecentYet.translated: Nog geen onlangs gespeelde kanale nie.

seo.homeH1.en: Watch Free Live TV, Radio & Webcams From Anywhere in the World
seo.homeH1.translated: Kyk Gratis Regstreekse TV, Radio & Webkameras van enige plek in die wêreld

seo.homeIntroTemplate.en: FreeTV Garden is a free streaming platform: spin the globe or pick a country to stream live TV, listen to live radio, and watch live webcams — no account, no app, no cost. {learnMoreLink} or see how we {alternativesLink}.
seo.homeIntroTemplate.translated: FreeTV Garden is 'n gratis stroomplatform: draai die aardbol of kies 'n land om regstreekse TV te stroom, na regstreekse radio te luister en live webkameras te kyk - geen rekening, geen toepassing, geen koste nie. {learnMoreLink} of kyk hoe ons {alternativesLink} .
